items.title: Reptile: A scalable meta-learning algorithm
items.summary: We’ve developed a simple meta-learning algorithm called Reptile which works by repeatedly sampling a task, performing stochastic gradient descent on it, and updating the initial parameters towards the final parameters learned on that task. items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了名为Reptile的元学习算法。该算法通过重复采样任务并执行随机梯度下降，将初始参数更新至任务学习后的参数方向。Reptile作为一种一阶元学习方法，在数学上与MAML相似，但仅需黑盒访问优化器（如SGD或Adam），在计算效率和性能上表现优异，为快速适应新任务提供了简洁且高效的解决方案。
